Codex review: this still needs some work.

**Summary**
The live structured-media echo defect remains on current main, and an open draft repair PR explicitly owns the fix.

Reproducibility: Current source establishes the path: structured-only live media is omitted, text-only projection cannot match the local attachment signature, and existing tests establish that the resulting unmatched echo creates a second row; no builds, tests, or live reproduction ran.

**Root-cause cluster**
Relationship: `canonical`
Canonical: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/issues/1493
Summary: This issue tracks the live structured-media correlation gap; an open repair owns it, while the merged reload repair covers only part of the surrounding media pipeline.

Members:
- `fixed_by_candidate`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/pull/1535 - Explicitly closes this issue and adds structured-media extraction and echo reconciliation.
- `partial_overlap`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/pull/1634 - Adds structured media preservation for history reloads but leaves the live parser and echo projection unchanged.
- `adjacent_distinct`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/issues/1840 - Concerns history merge dropping an already identified second message rather than failing attachment echo correlation.

Proposal only: this assessment does not dispatch repair, suppress jobs, mutate sibling items, close, or merge anything.

**Next step**
Update https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/pull/1535 (fix(chat): reconcile structured media echoes) against current main, resolve its recorded caption-escaping concern, and verify one rendered user row through the native Gateway path before landing.


<details>
<summary>Review details</summary>

Best possible solution:

Preserve structured user media through live echo projection while retaining local previews, caption escaping, and conservative correlation.

Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue?

Current source establishes the path: structured-only live media is omitted, text-only projection cannot match the local attachment signature, and existing tests establish that the resulting unmatched echo creates a second row; no builds, tests, or live reproduction ran.

Is this the best way to solve the issue?

Extending the existing typed media pipeline addresses the defect without weakening ambiguity safeguards; the merged history-only repair and existing send idempotency key do not solve live echo projection.

AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant.

Remaining risk / open question:

- The exact Gateway 2026.9.5 live frame and current-main visible result were not captured during this read-only review.
- The existing repair remains conflicting and has a recorded caption-escaping concern plus an unverified native Gateway scenario.

Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [a4dd026cc5f8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/commit/a4dd026cc5f85a444a0fcd05eef5b86282dbda8c).

</details>

<details>
<summary>Label changes</summary>

Label changes:

No label changes.

Label justifications:

- `P2`: Image sends display duplicate native-chat rows, with one Gateway send and one agent turn reported.
- `impact:ux-friction`: An extra text-only bubble makes a successful image send appear duplicated.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Evidence reviewed</summary>

What I checked:

- **Current main verified:** The checkout and GitHub main both resolve to a4dd026cc5f85a444a0fcd05eef5b86282dbda8c; git status remained clean. ([a4dd026cc5f8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/commit/a4dd026cc5f85a444a0fcd05eef5b86282dbda8c))
- **Live structured media remains omitted:** Live message parsing uses ExtractOrderedMessageContent without AppendOpenClawHistoryMedia; native user echo projection subsequently receives only rawText. ([`src/OpenClaw.Shared/OpenClawGatewayClient.cs:4211`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/blob/a4dd026cc5f85a444a0fcd05eef5b86282dbda8c/src/OpenClaw.Shared/OpenClawGatewayClient.cs#L4211), [a4dd026cc5f8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/commit/a4dd026cc5f85a444a0fcd05eef5b86282dbda8c))
- **Correlation still depends on text envelopes:** The live provider calls Project(rawText), which recognizes leading media-envelope lines rather than structured content; the matcher rejects an attachment-bearing local candidate when that envelope is absent. ([`src/OpenClaw.Tray.WinUI/Chat/OpenClawChatDataProvider.cs:1345`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/blob/a4dd026cc5f85a444a0fcd05eef5b86282dbda8c/src/OpenClaw.Tray.WinUI/Chat/OpenClawChatDataProvider.cs#L1345), [a4dd026cc5f8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/commit/a4dd026cc5f85a444a0fcd05eef5b86282dbda8c))
- **Existing tests establish the unmatched-row behavior:** ChatMessageReceived_NoEnvelopeEchoDoesNotConsumeSingleMediaPromotion expects two user rows after an image send receives a plain-text echo; the separate text-envelope regression expects one row and preserves the local preview. ([`tests/OpenClaw.Tray.Tests/OpenClawChatDataProviderTests.cs:3376`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/blob/a4dd026cc5f85a444a0fcd05eef5b86282dbda8c/tests/OpenClaw.Tray.Tests/OpenClawChatDataProviderTests.cs#L3376), [a4dd026cc5f8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/commit/a4dd026cc5f85a444a0fcd05eef5b86282dbda8c))
- **Merged history repair only partially overlaps:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/pull/1634 (fix: keep a multiline photo caption attached after reload) added structured __openclaw.media extraction to history parsing and attachment fallback to history replay; it did not extend the live echo path. ([`src/OpenClaw.Shared/OpenClawGatewayClient.cs:792`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/blob/18ea971620869f127c7acd7a2c484a372ecfa020/src/OpenClaw.Shared/OpenClawGatewayClient.cs#L792), [18ea97162086](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/commit/18ea971620869f127c7acd7a2c484a372ecfa020))
- **Open closing PR prevents issue cleanup:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/pull/1535 (fix(chat): reconcile structured media echoes) explicitly closes this issue and remains open, draft, and conflicting; its body reports focused regressions but marks native Gateway UI proof blocked, and its discussion records a caption-escaping concern. ([ea934c195e28](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/commit/ea934c195e2857ccaddae52f24d1bc56b8aa3b7b))

Likely related people:

- **Caleb Eden:** Raw commit a76c85218c7d6b82f2fa7234ee7e9c11848a3f0d adds src/OpenClaw.Tray.WinUI/Chat/ChatAttachmentEchoCorrelation.cs:38 relative to its recorded parents. This identifies author metadata, not feature responsibility or a PR merger. Fixes #1493

## Summary
- Preserve structured `__openclaw.media` user-turn metadata from live and history Gateway messages.
- Project structured user media into attachment correlation so local image echoes reconcile with the queued preview row.
- Keep structured-media history reloads to one user row with one attachment.

## Required proof pools
- `windows-winui-interactive`: native chat image attachment echo rendering changed.

## Validation
- `./build.ps1`: passed. All builds succeeded after one rerun. The first attempt hit a transient WinUI `input.json` file lock.
- `dotnet test ./tests/OpenClaw.Shared.Tests/OpenClaw.Shared.Tests.csproj --no-restore`: passed. Failed: 0, Passed: 4117, Skipped: 32, Total: 4149.
- `dotnet test ./tests/OpenClaw.Tray.Tests/OpenClaw.Tray.Tests.csproj --no-restore`: passed. Failed: 0, Passed: 3157, Skipped: 0, Total: 3157.
- Focused regression coverage added for live `__openclaw.media`, history `__openclaw.media`, structured media echo reconciliation, and structured media history reload.
- Rubber-duck code review: no significant issues found.

## Real behavior proof
- Current-head automated behavior proof: `ChatMessageReceived_StructuredMediaEcho_ReconcilesOneCleanRowAndPreservesLocalPreview` sends a local image attachment, processes a structured-media echo with plain text content, and asserts exactly one user row with the local preview attachment.
- Current-head automated reload proof: `LoadHistoryAsync_UserStructuredMedia_CreatesOneUserRowWithAttachment` asserts structured user media reloads as one user row with one safe Gateway attachment.
- `windows-winui-interactive`: Not verified / blocked. No live Gateway 2026.9.5 UI session was available in this run.

## What Problem This Solves

A photo caption with a line break loses its local file name after chat history reloads.

## User Impact

The caption `see this` plus a new line plus `photo` stays attached to `photo.png` instead of falling back to the gateway file name.

## Why This Change Was Made

The send cache replaced each newline with a space. History compares that caption to the original text, which still has the line break, so the match failed. The cache and the matcher now use the same echo text, and that text keeps the line breaks.

## Evidence

`AttachmentMetadata_MultilineCaption_MatchesTheHistoryText` stores `see this\nphoto` with `photo.png`, reloads the cache, and matches that same text. The reloaded caption still contains the newline.

## Change Type

- [ ] Chore or infrastructure

- [ ] Local MCP or `winnode`
- [ ] Gateway, connection, or pairing
- [ ] Setup or onboarding
- [ ] Permissions, privacy, or security
- [x] Tests, CI, or docs

## Required proof pools

- `windows-winui-interactive`: the changed result is the reloaded chat row. The headed trace below is on this machine. The maintainer-scheduled freeze run was not executed.

## Validation

Worktree `C:\Users\sebta\wt-wn-f030`.

- Tray: 3894 passed, 0 failed

- `./build.ps1`: exit 0
- `ParseChatHistoryPayload_OpenClawMedia_PreservesUserImageBesideCaption`: 1 passed

## Real Behavior Proof

- Environment tested: Windows 11, worktree `C:\Users\sebta\wt-wn-f030`, disposable gateway `ws://127.0.0.1:19031`
- PR head or commit tested: `113d58cce3f20c40da34337a413bab89a6adf74f`
- Exact steps or command run: native chat on that build sent caption `see this` plus a carriage return plus `photo` with `ocwn-1634.png`. The log line was `Sent chat message (14 chars, 1 attachment(s))`. A fresh launch reloaded history.
- Evidence after fix: with the cached file name changed to `local-proof.png` and the caption left matching history, the row showed `local-proof.png`. With that same cache caption flattened to `see this photo`, the row showed `ocwn-1634.png` and not `local-proof.png`.

Pull request creation is refused for this account (`CreatePullRequest` FORBIDDEN). The branch is on the fork.

Compare: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/compare/main...SebTardif:fix/f046-keep-second-identical-message?expand=1

Head: `56e94ccca1acdf0c3b8d06e23a2aec6483d0c4ae` on `SebTardif:fix/f046-keep-second-identical-message`

## What Problem

A stale history snapshot drops a second identical user message that the gateway already echoed.

## User Impact

Sending the same text twice while history is loading keeps the second echo. An optimistic row that still has no gateway id or sequence can still collapse into a matching history row from the last two seconds.

## Why

History merge kept a live row when its gateway id was missing from the snapshot, then dropped that row anyway when another history row had the same kind and text within two seconds. The snapshot that only contained the first "ok" removed the second one, and that echo was not applied again. The two-second match now applies only to an optimistic row that still has neither a gateway id nor a sequence.

## Evidence

`Merge_KeepsEchoedDuplicateMissingFromTheSnapshot` failed before the change: expected 2 rows, actual 1. After the change both merge tests passed. `Merge_DropsOptimisticDuplicateWithinTwoSeconds` still keeps a single history row.

`./build.ps1` succeeded.

Shared tests passed 4660, skipped 24, total 4684.

Tray tests passed 4476, skipped 0, total 4476.

## Real Behavior Proof

- Environment tested: `ChatHistoryState.MergeWithLiveEntries`. The tray window was not opened.
- Commit tested: `56e94ccca1acdf0c3b8d06e23a2aec6483d0c4ae`
- Steps: history contains one user row "ok" with gateway id `msg-1`. The live timeline contains a second "ok" with gateway id `msg-2` and sequence 2, one second later. Merge with `authoritative: false`.
- Evidence: the merge returns 2 rows, including metadata for `msg-2`. Before the change the same call returned 1 row.
- Observed result: the echoed second message is no longer removed by the first snapshot row.
- Screenshot: no.
- Not verified: the tray window was not opened. The fixture answers `chat.history` immediately, so it does not hold a snapshot that omits the second echo.

## Required proof pools

- `none`: no installer, WSL gateway, MXC, or ARM64 pool applies.
